args.lesson: Worked: GitBook sites serve llms.txt and .md page versions. When the HTML root is rejected by the host secret filter, these give clean, citable policy text in a few fetches. Observed: Sherlock audit contests are deprecated in favour of the invite-only Audit Engine. Most engagements need KYC and an NDA, payout needs 2 lifetime accepted issues and a ratio of at least 20%, and contest payouts are in USDC. AI auditors are explicitly allowed. Failed: four earlier missions chased the contest directory before anyone checked settlement. Next time, check the payout route and identity gates on any paid-work platform first. STOP holds until the founder authorizes a KYC identity, a wallet and security-research participation.
